an9.4:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an9.4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nandako upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhu dhammiyā kathāya sandesseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
an9.4:1.3: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena upaṭṭhānasālaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhāsi kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamāno.
an9.4:1.4: atha kho bhagavā kathāpariyosānaṃ viditvā ukkāsitvā aggalaṃ ākoṭesi.
an9.4:1.5: vivariṃsu kho te bhikkhu bhagavato dvāraṃ.
an9.4:2.1: atha kho bhagavā upaṭṭhānasālaṃ pāvisi. pavisitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an9.4:2.2: nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ etadavoca:
an9.4:2.3: dīgho kho tyāyaṃ nandaka dhammapariyāyo bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhāsi.
an9.4:2.4: api ca me piṭṭhi āgilāyati bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitassa kathāpariyosānaṃ āgamayamānassāti.
an9.4:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā nandako sārajjāyamānarūpo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca,
an9.4:3.2: na kho mayhaṃ bhante jānāma bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitoti.
an9.4:3.3: sace hi mayaṃ bhante jāneyyāma bhagavā bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitoti ettakampi no nappaṭibhāseyyāti.
an9.4:4.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ sārajjāyamānarūpaṃ viditvā āyasmantaṃ nandakaṃ etadavoca:
an9.4:4.3: evaṃ kho nandaka, tumhākaṃ patirūpaṃ kulaputtānaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ yaṃ tumhe dhammiyā kathāya sannisīdeyyātha.
an9.4:4.5: dhammī vā kathā, ariyo vā tuṇhībhāvo.
an9.4:4.6: saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti no ca sīlavā,
an9.4:4.9: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cāti.
an9.4:4.10: yato ca kho nandaka, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca, evaṃ so tenaṅgena paripūro hoti.
an9.4:5.1: saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca, no ca lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa.
an9.4:5.4: kiṃ tāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassāti.
an9.4:5.5: yato ca kho nandaka bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca, lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, evaṃ so tenaṅgena paripūro hoti.
an9.4:6.1: saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca, lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ ceto samathassa. na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya.
an9.4:6.6: evameva kho nandaka bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya,
an9.4:6.9: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, lābhī ca adhipaññādhamma vipassanāyāti.
an9.4:7.1: yato ca kho nandaka, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya, evaṃ so tenaṅgena paripūro hotīti.
an9.4:7.3: idaṃ vatvā sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
an9.4:8.1: atha kho āyasmā nandako acirapakkantassa bhagavato bhikkhu āmantesi:
an9.4:8.2: idānāvuso bhagavā catuhi padehi kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
an9.4:8.3: “saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti, no ca sīlavā,
an9.4:8.6: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cāti.
an9.4:8.7: yato ca kho nandaka bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca, evaṃ so tenaṅgena paripūro hoti.
an9.4:8.8: saddho ca nandaka bhikkhu hoti sīlavā ca, no ca lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa …pe…
an9.4:8.9: lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya,
an9.4:8.11: seyyathāpi nandaka, pāṇako catuppādako, tassassa eko pādo omako lāmako,
an9.4:8.13: evameva kho nandaka, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāya,
an9.4:8.16: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāyāti.
an9.4:8.17: yato ca kho nandaka, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya,
an9.4:9.1: pañcime āvuso. ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:9.3: idhāvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an9.4:9.4: yathā yathā āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti, tathā tathā so satthu piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca
an9.4:9.5: ayaṃ āvuso, paṭhamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:10.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti. yathā yathā āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe…
an9.4:10.2: brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme atthapaṭisaṃvedī ca hoti dhammapaṭisaṃvedī ca,
an9.4:10.3: ayaṃ āvuso, dutiyo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:11.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an9.4:11.2: yathā yathā āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti, tathā tathā so tasmiṃ dhamme gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ paññāya ativijjha passati,
an9.4:11.3: ayaṃ āvuso tatiyo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:12.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an9.4:12.2: yathā yathā āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti. tathā tathā naṃ sabrahmacārī uttariṃ sambhāventi,
an9.4:12.3: “addhā ayamāyasmā patto vā pacchati vā” ti,
an9.4:12.4: ayaṃ āvuso, catuttho ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:13.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an9.4:13.2: yathā yathā āvuso, bhikkhu bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ …pe… brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti. tattha tattha ye te bhikkhu sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti, te taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā viriyaṃ ārabhanti appattassa pattiyā, anadhigatassa adhigamāya asacchikatassa sacchikiriyāya.
an9.4:13.3: ye pana tattha bhikkhu arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā, te taṃ dhammaṃ sutvā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāraññeva anuyuttā viharanti.
an9.4:13.4: ayaṃ āvuso, pañcamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāya.
an9.4:13.5: ime kho āvuso, pañca ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavaṇe, kālena dhammasākacchāyāti.
